shortDescription: Manage routes on IBM AIX systems.

options.name: action
options.description: Specifies the action to perform. C(add) Adds a route. C(flush) Removes all routes. C(delete) Deletes a specific route. C(change) Changes aspects of a route (such as its gateway). C(get) Lookup and display the route for a destination. C(set) Set the policy and weight attributes of a route.

options.name: arguments
options.description: Additional route-specific arguments like `-weight`, `-policy`, etc., to be appended after the gateway.

options.name: destination
options.description: The destination network or host IP address.

options.name: family
options.description: Specifies the address family, such as `-inet` or `-inet6`.

options.name: flags
options.description: List of additional flags for the route command such as `net` or`host`.

options.name: flush
options.description: Corresponds to the `-f` flag. Purges all entries in the routing table that are not associated with network interfaces.

options.name: gateway
options.description: The gateway IP address for routing.

options.name: ioctl_preference
options.description: Corresponds to the `-C` flag. Specifies preference for ioctl calls over routing messages for adding and removing routes.

options.name: netmask
options.description: Specifies the network mask for the destination.

options.name: numeric
options.description: Corresponds to the `-n` flag. Displays host and network names numerically rather than symbolically.

options.name: prefixlen
options.description: Specifies the prefix length of the destination.

options.name: verbose
options.description: Corresponds to the `-v` flag. Prints additional details.
